| `construct.expected` | `{"total": "favors_walkers", "walking_any": "favors_walkers", "hours_5plus": "favors_walkers", "womac_walk": "favors_walkers", "pace_20m": "favors_walkers", "womac_function": "favors_walkers", "total_minus_walking": "none_stated", "sitting_long": "none_stated", "light_sport": "moderate", "moderate_sport": "moderate", "strenuous_sport": "moderate", "muscle": "moderate", "light_housework": "little_or_none", "heavy_housework": "little_or_none", "home_repairs": "little_or_none", "yard": "little_or_none", "garden": "little_or_none", "caring": "little_or_none", "work_active": "little_or_none", "koos_sport": "relative_to_womac_walk"}` | Spec 'Analyses' items 2-3, recorded before computing. WOMAC function is 'between the two' in the spec; it is kept with the convergent measures and expected to favor walkers, more weakly than the walking measures (read by size; no rule tests this). KOOS sport is judged relative to WOMAC walking difficulty (smaller standardized difference), sitting has no stated expectation. PASE total minus walking has none stated: the spec judges it by the standardized-difference bands without predicting one, and the composite includes items expected to show a moderate link |  |

| `construct.higher_is_better` | `{"total": true, "total_minus_walking": true, "walking_any": true, "hours_5plus": true, "pace_20m": true, "koos_sport": true, "womac_function": false, "womac_walk": false, "sitting_long": false, "light_sport": true, "moderate_sport": true, "strenuous_sport": true, "muscle": true, "light_housework": true, "heavy_housework": true, "home_repairs": true, "yard": true, "garden": true, "caring": true, "work_active": true}` | Which direction of each measure favors Walkers, for reading a contrast's sign. PASE scores and items: more activity is higher. 20-m pace is in m/sec (AllClinical00_Contents.pdf p.15). KOOS: score = 100 - sum*100/(items*4), so 100 is no problems (KOOSG.sas, AllClinical00_Comments.pdf p.224). WOMAC function and walking difficulty: higher is more difficulty (items scored 0-4, AllClinical00_Contents.pdf p.67). sitting_long false is a descriptive direction only: construct.expected is none_stated, so no claim rests on it |  |
